build_docnn_representation: build a DocNNRepresentation CNN-based document representation model with configurable kernel sizes and pooling
create_docnn_config: create a DocNNRepresentation Config with dropout, CNNParams kernel sizes, and PoolingType settings
run_docnn_forward: run the DocNNRepresentation forward pass on embedded tokens tensor of size N x W x D
review_conv_and_pool: review the conv_and_pool method that applies ReLU convolution then MAX, MEAN, or LOGSUMEXP pooling
test_docnn_initialization: test DocNNRepresentation initialization with embed_dim to create Conv1d layers and compute representation_dim
